ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' — ISO/LNK script host spawning rundll32/regsvr32 DLL sideload from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts Lazarus Group's (Hidden Cobra / Labyrinth Chollima) signature Dream Job execution chain where an ISO/archive-delivered LNK launches a script host (wscript/cscript/cmd) that proxy-executes a malicious DLL via rundll32/regsvr32 from a user-writable directory. This loader-staging pattern is consistent across Lazarus fake-recruiter campaigns (LinkedIn/email decoy PDFs paired with sideloaded loaders).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","control.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where match(process, "(?i)(Users|Temp|AppData|ProgramData|Downloads)") AND match(process, "(?i)\.(dll|ocx|cpl)") 
| where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","control.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Users","Temp","AppData","ProgramData","Downloads")   // user-writable staging dir
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".dll",".ocx",".cpl")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","explorer.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","control.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Users","Temp","AppData","ProgramData","Downloads")
| where CommandLine has_any (".dll",".ocx",".cpl")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Dream Job - Script Host Spawning rundll32/regsvr32 Loading DLL From User-Writable Path
status: experimental
description: Detects Lazarus Group loader staging where a script host or cmd spawns rundll32/regsvr32 to proxy-execute a DLL/OCX/CPL from a user-writable directory.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\control.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  selection_ext:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.dll'
      - '.ocx'
      - '.cpl'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_path and selection_ext
falsepositives:
  - Legacy in-house installers that stage helper DLLs in ProgramData
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.g0032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.EXE) @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*Users* OR *Temp* OR *AppData* OR *ProgramData* OR *Downloads*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(wscript|cscript|cmd|explorer)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(rundll32|regsvr32|control)\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)(Users|Temp|AppData|ProgramData|Downloads)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\.(dll|ocx|cpl)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Lazarus Dream Job intrusions repeatedly chain a decoy-document/ISO → LNK → script host → rundll32/regsvr32 proxy-load of a staged loader DLL (rather than direct EXE execution) to evade signature controls. ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus supply-chain implant beaconing to GitHub/cloud web-service dead-drop from non-browser signed app
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus (ZINC / Diamond Sleet) supply-chain implant pattern — exemplified by the 3CXDesktopApp and X_TRADER trojanizations — where a sideloaded payload inside a legitimately-signed desktop application retrieves C2 stage-data (e.g. encrypted ICO files) from GitHub or Azure-mimicking web services. Flags non-browser application processes reaching GitHub raw content for bidirectional web-service C2.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.site IN ("raw.githubusercontent.com","github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com") AND NOT Web.app IN ("chrome.exe","firefox.exe","msedge.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","git.exe","code.exe","github.exe","curl.exe") by Web.src Web.app Web.site Web.url Web.http_user_agent Web.dest 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("raw.githubusercontent.com","github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","git.exe","code.exe","github.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any ("Program Files","AppData","ProgramData","Users")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), Hits=count(), Urls=make_set(RemoteUrl, 10) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Url has_any ("raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","github.com/")
| where HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Mozilla"   // implant fetch carries no browser UA
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, SrcUsername, Url, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, DstIpAddr, FileName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*githubusercontent.com OR *github.com) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\git.exe OR *\Git.exe OR *\Code.exe OR *\code.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\brave.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(raw\.githubusercontent\.com|objects\.githubusercontent\.com|github\.com)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|git|code|github|curl|powershell)\.exe/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count > 0
